description: This is a rectangular dining table with a light-colored wooden tabletop that has a visible wood grain pattern. The tabletop appears to be made of planks. The table is supported by a robust base constructed with two 'X'-shaped legs made of black metal. Connecting these legs is a dark brown, rectangular wooden beam, adding a rustic and sturdy aesthetic. The overall design suggests a blend of industrial and natural elements, suitable for various dining or working spaces.
